project_type: TypeScript monorepo (pnpm workspaces + turborepo) with durable function system backed by Inngest
build_system: pnpm + turbo. Per-package scripts: typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test:unit (vitest run). Monorepo-wide: pnpm -r typecheck, turbo typecheck
test_framework: vitest with vi.mock/vi.hoisted pattern. Tests co-located with source (*.test.ts). Tests mock the inngest client and exercise handler logic directly.
build_command: cd packages/functions && pnpm typecheck && cd ../inngest-functions && pnpm typecheck
test_command: cd packages/functions && pnpm test:unit && cd ../inngest-functions && pnpm test:unit
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm typecheck in packages/functions and packages/inngest-functions. 2. pnpm test:unit in both packages. 3. Confirm the serve endpoint (apps/api/src/routes/inngest.ts) still type-checks.
environment_constraints: Open internet. INNGEST_EVENT_KEY/INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY not available (not needed for typecheck/unit tests). The Inngest client is lazy-initialized so imports don't fail without keys.
contribution_requirements: Changes must typecheck. Tests must pass. Business logic in function handlers must not change behavior. The serve endpoint must still work (inngest client + functions array passed to inngestServe).
key_patterns: 1. Function files export const created via inngest.createFunction(config, trigger, handler). 2. Handler destructures {event, step} and casts event.data. 3. step.run/step.sendEvent/step.waitForEvent/step.sleep are the durable primitives. 4. On-failure handlers are separate functions triggered by 'inngest/function.failed' with if-filter on function_id. 5. NonRetriableError imported from 'inngest' in 2 files. 6. Tests mock inngest.createFunction and capture the handler to invoke it directly.
directory_structure: packages/functions/ - provider-agnostic types (DurableFunctionConfig, StepContext, etc). packages/inngest-functions/ - Inngest-specific implementation (client, adapter, 29 function definitions in src/functions/). apps/api/ - Hono API app with inngest serve route.
